blueprints.observation: Hardware page size is strictly 16384 bytes (16 KB) with 30 active DART IOMMU channels.
blueprints.reengineering_action: Allocate camera and audio DMA ring buffers using `posix_memalign(&ptr, 16384, aligned_size)`. This matches the Apple T8110 DART page tables 1:1, preventing virtual-to-physical IOMMU page faults during direct USB/Thunderbolt DMA.

blueprints.subsystem: SIMD Vector Alignment & L1 Cache Bypass
blueprints.observation: CPU cache line size is 128 bytes with 64 KB L1D cache per core.
blueprints.reengineering_action: Pad all Bayer RAW pixel scanlines to multiples of 128 bytes. Use `MTLCPUCacheMode.writeCombined` on shared buffers so camera DMA and GPU writes stream directly into RAM without thrashing the CPU's 64 KB L1 data cache.

blueprints.subsystem: Heterogeneous Core Affinity (P-Core vs E-Core Scheduling)
blueprints.observation: Apple Silicon M4 Pro topology has 10 Performance Cores (perflevel0) and 4 Efficiency Cores (perflevel1).
blueprints.reengineering_action: Explicitly assign camera ISP debayering and 120Hz ProMotion render loops to `qos_class_t.QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE` (which locks threads to P-cores 0-9 at maximum clock frequencies). Route file indexing, logging, and trash airlock cleanup to `QOS_CLASS_BACKGROUND` (pinned to E-cores 10-13).

blueprints.observation: Total physical RAM is 48.0 GB unified memory shared dynamically across CPU, GPU, and Neural Engine.
blueprints.reengineering_action: Set `recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize` guardrails. On a 48 GB Mac, we can allocate up to 36 GB directly to Metal compute tensors with zero swap thrashing, leaving 12 GB for OS, UI, and live agent sub-processes.

blueprints.observation: macOS WindowServer composites windows via CoreAnimation surfaces.
blueprints.reengineering_action: Bypass WindowServer double-buffering by binding `CAMetalLayer.presentsWithTransaction = false` and submitting frames via `MTLCommandBuffer.present(drawable, afterMinimumDuration: 1.0 / 120.0)`. Ensures exact 8.33 ms frame delivery aligned to the Liquid Retina XDR display.
